verses.text: 'Flee for safety, O sons of Benjamin, From the midst of Jerusalem! Now blow a trumpet in Tekoa And raise a signal over Beth-haccerem; For evil looks down from the north, And a great destruction.
verses.textZh: 便雅憫人哪，你們要逃出耶路撒冷，在提哥亞吹角，在伯哈基琳立號旗；因為有災禍與大毀滅從北方張望。

verses.text: 'The comely and dainty one, the daughter of Zion, I will cut off.
verses.textZh: 那秀美嬌嫩的錫安女子（就是指民的意思），我必剪除。

verses.text: 'Shepherds and their flocks will come to her, They will pitch [their] tents around her, They will pasture each in his place.
verses.textZh: 牧人必引他們的羊群到他那著，在他周圍支搭帳棚，各在自己所佔之地使羊吃草。

verses.text: 'Prepare war against her; Arise, and let us attack at noon. Woe to us, for the day declines, For the shadows of the evening lengthen!
verses.textZh: 你們要準備攻擊他。起來罷，我們可以趁午時上去。哀哉！日已漸斜，晚影拖長了。

verses.text: 'Arise, and let us attack by night And destroy her palaces!'
verses.textZh: 起來罷，我們夜間上去，毀壞他的宮殿。

verses.text: For thus says the LORD of hosts, 'Cut down her trees And cast up a siege against Jerusalem. This is the city to be punished, In whose midst there is only oppression.
verses.textZh: 因為萬軍之耶和華如此說：你們要砍伐樹木，築壘攻打耶路撒冷。這就是那該罰的城，其中盡是欺壓。

verses.text: 'As a well keeps its waters fresh, So she keeps fresh her wickedness. Violence and destruction are heard in her; Sickness and wounds are ever before Me.
verses.textZh: 井怎樣湧出水來，這城也照樣湧出惡來；在其間常聽見有強暴毀滅的事，病患損傷也常在我面前。

verses.text: 'Be warned, O Jerusalem, Or I shall be alienated from you, And make you a desolation, A land not inhabited.'
verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷啊，你當受教，免得我心與你生疏，免得我使你荒涼，成為無人居住之地。

verses.text: Thus says the LORD of hosts, 'They will thoroughly glean as the vine the remnant of Israel; Pass your hand again like a grape gatherer Over the branches.'
verses.textZh: 萬軍之耶和華曾如此說：敵人必擄盡以色列剩下的民，如同摘淨葡萄一樣。你要像摘葡萄的人摘了又摘，回手放在筐子裡。

verses.text: To whom shall I speak and give warning That they may hear? Behold, their ears are closed And they cannot listen. Behold, the word of the LORD has become a reproach to them; They have no delight in it.
verses.textZh: 現在我可以向誰說話作見證，使他們聽呢？他們的耳朵未受割禮，不能聽見。看哪，耶和華的話他們以為羞辱，不以為喜悅。

verses.text: But I am full of the wrath of the LORD; I am weary with holding [it] in. 'Pour [it] out on the children in the street And on the gathering of young men together; For both husband and wife shall be taken, The aged and the very old.
verses.textZh: 因此我被耶和華的忿怒充滿，難以含忍。我要傾在街中的孩童和聚會的少年人身上，連夫帶妻，並年老的與日子滿足的都必被擒拿。

verses.text: 'Their houses shall be turned over to others, Their fields and their wives together; For I will stretch out My hand Against the inhabitants of the land,' declares the LORD.
verses.textZh: 他們的房屋、田地，和妻子都必轉歸別人；我要伸手攻擊這地的居民。這是耶和華說的。

verses.text: 'For from the least of them even to the greatest of them, Everyone is greedy for gain, And from the prophet even to the priest Everyone deals falsely.
verses.textZh: 因為他們從最小的到至大的都一味地貪婪，從先知到祭司都行事虛謊。

verses.text: 'They have healed the brokenness of My people superficially, Saying, 'Peace, peace,' But there is no peace.
verses.textZh: 他們輕輕忽忽地醫治我百姓的損傷，說：平安了！平安了！其實沒有平安。

verses.text: 'Were they ashamed because of the abomination they have done? They were not even ashamed at all; They did not even know how to blush. Therefore they shall fall among those who fall; At the time that I punish them, They shall be cast down,' says the LORD.
verses.textZh: 他們行可憎的事知道慚愧麼？不然，他們毫不慚愧，也不知羞恥。因此，他們必在仆倒的人中仆倒；我向他們討罪的時候，他們必致跌倒。這是耶和華說的。

verses.text: Thus says the LORD, 'Stand by the ways and see and ask for the ancient paths, Where the good way is, and walk in it; And you will find rest for your souls. But they said, 'We will not walk [in it].'
verses.textZh: 耶和華如此說：你們當站在路上察看，訪問古道，哪是善道，便行在其間；這樣，你們心裡必得安息。他們卻說：我們不行在其間。

verses.text: 'And I set watchmen over you, [saying], 'Listen to the sound of the trumpet!' But they said, 'We will not listen.'
verses.textZh: 我設立守望的人照管你們，說：要聽角聲。他們卻說：我們不聽。

verses.text: 'Therefore hear, O nations, And know, O congregation, what is among them.
verses.textZh: 列國啊，因此你們當聽！會眾啊，要知道他們必遭遇的事。

verses.text: 'Hear, O earth: behold, I am bringing disaster on this people, The fruit of their plans, Because they have not listened to My words, And as for My law, they have rejected it also.
verses.textZh: 地啊，當聽！我必使災禍臨到這百姓，就是他們意念所結的果子；因為他們不聽從我的言語，至於我的訓誨（或譯：律法），他們也厭棄了。

verses.text: 'For what purpose does frankincense come to Me from Sheba And the sweet cane from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable And your sacrifices are not pleasing to Me.'
verses.textZh: 從示巴出的乳香，從遠方出的菖蒲（或譯：甘蔗）奉來給我有何益呢？你們的燔祭不蒙悅納；你們的平安祭，我也不喜悅。

verses.text: Therefore, thus says the LORD, 'Behold, I am laying stumbling blocks before this people. And they will stumble against them, Fathers and sons together; Neighbor and friend will perish.'
verses.textZh: 所以耶和華如此說：我要將絆腳石放在這百姓前面。父親和兒子要一同跌在其上；鄰舍與朋友也都滅亡。

verses.text: Thus says the LORD, 'Behold, a people is coming from the north land, And a great nation will be aroused from the remote parts of the earth.
verses.textZh: 耶和華如此說：看哪，有一種民從北方而來，並有一大國被激動，從地極來到。

verses.text: 'They seize bow and spear; They are cruel and have no mercy; Their voice roars like the sea, And they ride on horses, Arrayed as a man for the battle Against you, O daughter of Zion!'
verses.textZh: 他們拿弓和槍，性情殘忍，不施憐憫；他們的聲音像海浪匉訇。錫安城（原文是女子）啊，他們騎馬都擺隊伍，如上戰場的人要攻擊你。

verses.text: We have heard the report of it; Our hands are limp. Anguish has seized us, Pain as of a woman in childbirth.
verses.textZh: 我們聽見他們的風聲，手就發軟；痛苦將我們抓住，疼痛彷彿產難的婦人。

verses.text: Do not go out into the field And do not walk on the road, For the enemy has a sword, Terror is on every side.
verses.textZh: 你們不要往田野去，也不要行在路上，因四圍有仇敵的刀劍和驚嚇。

verses.text: O daughter of my people, put on sackcloth And roll in ashes; Mourn as for an only son, A lamentation most bitter. For suddenly the destroyer Will come upon us.
verses.textZh: 我民（原文是民女）哪，應當腰束麻布，滾在灰中。你要悲傷，如喪獨生子痛痛哭號，因為滅命的要忽然臨到我們。

verses.text: 'I have made you an assayer [and] a tester among My people, That you may know and assay their way.'
verses.textZh: 我使你在我民中為高臺（或譯：試驗人的），為保障，使你知道試驗他們的行動。

verses.text: All of them are stubbornly rebellious, Going about as a talebearer. [They are] bronze and iron; They, all of them, are corrupt.
verses.textZh: 他們都是極悖逆的，往來讒謗人。他們是銅是鐵，都行壞事。

verses.text: The bellows blow fiercely, The lead is consumed by the fire; In vain the refining goes on, But the wicked are not separated.
verses.textZh: 風箱吹火，鉛被燒燬；他們煉而又煉，終是徒然；因為惡劣的還未除掉。

verses.text: They call them rejected silver, Because the LORD has rejected them.
verses.textZh: 人必稱他們為被棄的銀渣，因為耶和華已經棄掉他們。
